entries.title: A task's card has tabs
entries.body: When a task has a browser, its card shows tabs under the title: Info, with everything the card showed before, and Browser, which watches the crewmate's page. A browser with two pages gets a tab for each, named Browser and the page's title. Tab and the arrow keys move between them, and command search has Show Info, Show Browser, Next tab and Previous tab.
